validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye from the 200-dpi page images, 2 pages per image at 0.7x (11 images) plus full-resolution zooms; tesseract only as a draft. Numerical index checked by rendering the expected (part, page, ref) list beside each printed index row (6 images).
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except: hood_frame ref 23 and electrical_system_hardware ref 13 are not printed (the index has neither). pto_clutch_kit runs 1-29 and continues 30-34 under "THE FOLLOWING PARTS NOT INCLUDED IN KIT" (stored as its own section). 4 unnumbered rows kept (fuel line insulation C28030, engine charge harness C33300, wire clip C28962, headlight assembly C32178 on page 39); the index lists them with a blank ref. Many refs are printed on two or more rows (model, serial, transaxle or size alternatives).
validation.quantities: All 554 rows have a qty; 7 are UAR. REQ'D printed out of register on printed pages 11, 19, 35 and 39 (PTO clutch kit, steering gear, electrical system before-S/N page, electrical hardware, headlight): mapped in sequence, counts equal, 98 rows flagged 'inferred qty'.
validation.numericalIndex: 531 index entries (pages 46-48) compared row by row against the 531 non-NSS/NLA table rows, both directions. Every table part number is in the index except C15096 (19/2). Index differences (table kept, rows flagged): C26325 indexed at 19/2 (table ref 1); C27651 printed for C27561 (31/25); C29192 at 15/5 (table 7); C29245 at page 23 (table 25); C31035 35/1 printed twice; C43044 printed "34 50" (35/10); 014- 712 and 132- 310 (page 25) printed with no ref; 129-2175 printed for 195-2175 (7/6). The index prints C30260 and C30279 where the table prints 30260 and 30279, and prints hardware with a space and leading zero (131- 911, 013- 624, 061- 612). Part numbers that appear only in notes or descriptions (not rows, not index): C28937, C35291, C33171, C33170, C31336, C31335, C30161, C30162, C27569, C33025, C32396, C32397.
validation.partNoForms: Case/Ingersoll C numbers and hardware codes are printed closed up in the tables (C29070, 113-102) and stored the same; footnote marks (*, **, †, ††) are kept in partNoAsPrinted only. Short hardware codes 13-624, 13-628, 14-712, 61-612 stored as printed. 30260 and 30279 stored as C30260 / C30279 (index form), printed form kept. 20 NSS rows and 3 NLA rows are stored as NSS / NLA with no source. No Briggs (BR) or H numbers in this book.
